name: @tekmerion/sdk
description: Tekmerion instructions, authenticated bigint views and Solana RPC reads and execution

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run typecheck:examples && node --test tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src/*.ts tests/*.mjs examples/*.ts package.json tsconfig*.json .prettierrc.json README.md
